title: Authoritative Prescribed Bottom-Head qbot and Mass Trace

authoritative_qbot_trace.current_common_route_hazard: initialize_reference_state_binding initializes state_binding%qbot from request%boundary%bottom_flux; reference_richards_legacy_solve later publishes result%bottom_flux = state_binding%qbot. Because HeadCalc mode 5 does not overwrite state%qbot, admitting mode 5 without a post-HeadCalc binding would publish the initialized request value rather than the B1.10 authoritative mode-5 qbot.
authoritative_qbot_trace.legacy_publication_stage: accepted HeadCalc step -> SoilWater(3) -> fluxes() -> integral(3)
authoritative_qbot_trace.legacy_mode5_formula: qbot = qtop + qrosum + qdrtot + (volact-volm1)/dt - qssdisum; if swmacro == 1 then qbot = qbot - QMaPo
authoritative_qbot_trace.sign: positive qbot is water entering the simulated soil profile through the lower boundary; negative qbot is water leaving the profile
authoritative_qbot_trace.timing: qbot is materialized only after the Richards step has been accepted by the internal HeadCalc retry path; terminal canonical nonconvergence returns before this stage
authoritative_qbot_trace.admission_requirement: the mode-5 common route must reproduce the existing B1.10 post-HeadCalc qbot materialization before result%bottom_flux can be authoritative; simply enabling the validator is not admissible

mass_accounting_trace.authoritative_interval_integrator: F-CI11 controlled B1.10 integral(3, trial_mass) postimage
exact_once_chain: B1.10 fluxes() materializes qbot for the accepted internal soil-water step
F-CI11 integral(3, trial_mass) forms qbotts = qbot*dt exactly once for that timestep
record_b1_10_trial_mass_step adds qbotts to either bottom_in or bottom_out exactly once
mod_b1_10_mass_seam copies trial_mass%total_in and trial_mass%total_out into canonical mass accounting and does not add bottom flux separately
the recoverable reference model forwards those total_in/total_out values to the transaction outcome without re-adding qbot
mass_accounting_trace.rejected_trial_semantics: F-CI13 canonical terminal Richards nonconvergence returns before SoilWater(3), integral(3), process-state updates and time advancement, so that failed step does not enter trial mass accounting.
mass_accounting_trace.rollback_semantics: F-KT restores the committed checkpoint and attempt context on rejection. The B1.10 legacy attempt capsule captures/restores qbot-related integration globals including iqbot, iqbdo, iqbup, cqbot, cqbotdo and cqbotup, preventing rejected-attempt accounting leakage.
mass_accounting_trace.ownership_boundary: F-SI16 qualifies the focused solver/boundary qbot semantics and their compatibility with the existing external-flux mass seam. Whole-interval mass completeness and composed runtime acceptance remain F-KT/composed-runtime ownership.
